name: Dia
source:
"If you don't want to die, you mustn't misbehave."
 
A boy who has become a devil, spending eternity in nothingness.
Once beloved as the prince of this land,
he now exists by consuming the souls of men.
 

[From [url=https://black00crown.com/en.html]English official site[/url]]
